---
title: "Tools & Reports"
description: "Dashboards, report samples, reading guides, classification references, and reusable analytics tools from Sun Data Analytics."
---

Tools & Reports is a public shelf of dashboards, report examples, reference guides, and reusable analysis resources. These are visible artifacts, not service descriptions: examples of how Sun Data Analytics organizes performance data, creator content, text evidence, and reporting logic into things people can inspect.

## Report Companions

The reports are meant to be read, not just displayed. These companion pieces explain the charts, categories, and source limits behind the public examples.

```{=html}
<section class="companion-shelf" aria-label="Report companion resources">
  <a class="companion-tile" href="insights/07_reading_creator_report_charts.html">
    <span class="tool-index">Chart guide</span>
    <strong>How to Read Creator Report Charts</strong>
    <p>Explains boxplots, trends, content type comparisons, audience composition, timing, topics, and tags.</p>
  </a>

  <a class="companion-tile" href="insights/06_classification_definitions.html">
    <span class="tool-index">Classification reference</span>
    <strong>Stream Title Classification Guide</strong>
    <p>Shows how titles are grouped into categories that support creator analytics and content comparison.</p>
  </a>

  <a class="companion-tile" href="report_sample/latest_ANN_report.html">
    <span class="tool-index">Media report</span>
    <strong>Anime News Network Report</strong>
    <p>Shows how public media source material can be collected, structured, and turned into a readable report.</p>
  </a>
</section>
```

## Trend And Research Utilities

Some tools are built for monitoring a changing context rather than producing a single report. They can support creator strategy, media tracking, topic monitoring, or research work where the important question is what is changing around the client, audience, or industry.

```{=html}
<section class="research-utility-panel">
  <div>
    <p class="service-kicker">Monitoring patterns</p>
    <h3>Public signals become structured records.</h3>
    <p>Reusable collection and review patterns can track public sources, media coverage, topics, publication dates, and other context that helps explain what is happening around the work.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="research-signal-strip" aria-hidden="true">
    <span>source</span>
    <span>topic</span>
    <span>date</span>
    <span>category</span>
    <span>note</span>

</section>
```
